idea-plugin.name: Sourcebeam
idea-plugin.description:
Live code sharing from your IDE to a read-only browser page. This plugin broadcasts the open project to a sourcebeam viewer session: anyone with an invite link watches the code change live, with no editing and no code execution.

Think of it as a lightweight, read-only alternative to Code With Me for the cases where the audience only needs to watch: teaching, mentoring, code walkthroughs, demos and review sessions. Viewers need nothing but a link. The server runs on your own Cloudflare account; this plugin is the host side.

  • Every text file the project's .gitignore doesn't exclude is sent, up to a server-published size cap; binaries are skipped.
  • .gitignore decides what stays private, .env files and keys included; nothing under .git/ is ever sent.
  • The host token lives in the IDE password safe, never in a settings file.
